title: PullRequestReviewEvidence
description: Evidence envelope consumed by `faraday-validator evaluate-pr` (Faraday Review Phase 1, Correction 4). Distinct from review-evidence.schema.json, which is the TR-004 work-session review artifact and is unchanged; one authority per contract name (ADR-0001). Phase 1 producers are deterministic: `provider_results` and `required_providers` ship as EMPTY ARRAYS, not absent keys, so Phase 2 populates them without a schema migration. Migration discipline (Ruling 16): reviewer_version, evidence_class, deterministic_findings, provider_results, and required_providers are OPTIONAL in this minor release and are not promoted to required in Phase 1. The deterministic_findings item shape duplicates deterministic-finding.schema.json for standalone validation; consumer tests keep them identical.

reviewer_version.description: Tag or commit of the producing plane. Phase 1: the deterministic plane's own version; recorded, not gated (Correction 5). Self-attesting-evidence checks activate in Phase 2.

evidence_class.description: Canonical enum: evidence-class.schema.json (kept identical by consumer tests). Validators additionally enforce a hardcoded runtime allowlist and fail closed on unknown values.

provider_results.description: Phase 2 defines the item contract (ReviewProviderResult). Phase 1 producers always emit []. The item shape is deliberately unconstrained here so Phase 2 constrains it in a minor release.

required_providers.description: Providers policy required for this evaluation. Phase 1 producers always emit [].
